title: Woolcutting
body:
_(Want to overhaul cutting for ALL of Minecraft's block sets? Check out [**Palette**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/palette)!)_ Minecraft 26.3 is adding new Wool Stairs and Slabs, but without cutting recipes, they can't be obtained as efficiently as those for stone blocks. So let's fix that! Adds Stonecutter recipes for Wool Stairs, Slabs, and Carpets. ## ### MintRefresh:
